title: Learning from Each Other
text:
Our city is home to people from many countries. In my class, there are students from Poland, Japan, and Brazil. We celebrate different holidays together. Every year, we have a food festival where everyone brings a dish from their country.

Learning about other cultures is interesting. My friend from Japan taught me how to use chopsticks. I also shared some words from my first language. Cultural diversity makes our school a friendly place to learn.

questions.text: Which countries are mentioned in the first paragraph?
What does the writer's friend from Japan teach the writer in the second paragraph?
What can you infer about the food festival at the writer's school?
options: It helps students learn about different cultures

questions.text: Why does the writer think the school is a friendly place?
options: Because the school has no rules
Because students share and learn from each other
Because all students are from one country

vocabulary.definition: to do something special for a holiday or important day
a special event with food, music, or activities
the existence of many different kinds of people or things
two thin sticks used to pick up food

paragraph_translations: Наше місто є домівкою для людей з багатьох країн. У моєму класі є учні з Польщі, Японії та Бразилії. Ми разом святкуємо різні свята. Щороку у нас відбувається фестиваль їжі, на якому кожен приносить страву зі своєї країни.

Вивчати інші культури цікаво. Мій друг з Японії навчив мене користуватися паличками для їжі. Також вдалося поділитися словами з моєї рідної мови. Культурна різноманітність робить нашу школу дружнім місцем для навчання.
